# Retail Assistants Christmas 2026 - Expressions of Interest
**🎄 Christmas Retail Assistants - Expressions of Interest 2026** **🎄**
_Join the magic of the festive season at Broadleaf!_

...

During the Christmas season at Broadleaf, our Team Members go the extra mile to make the holidays special for our customers! We're now looking for enthusiastic Christmas Team Members to join us for the festive season, helping to create an exceptional shopping experience for everyone!
**Our stores are the go-to destination for all holiday shopping needs, so we need people who:**
🎁 Have passion, energy and enthusiasm for customer service
🎁 Have excellent communication skills
🎁 Can keep their cool and thrive in a fast-paced Christmas environment
🎁 Are flexible to work late nights, weekends and pick up extra shifts when required
Whether you're kickstarting your retail career or looking to earn extra over the holidays, this is a fantastic opportunity to be part of something festive and fun.
These roles are fixed term, starting in early October and extending through to just after Christmas or into January, based on store needs. If you're available throughout this period, we encourage you to apply now for a Christmas position with us!
**When submitting your application, please make sure to select 'Christmas' in the 'Employment Type' section and indicate the store(s) where you are willing to work. This will help us match you with the right location!**
**Entitlement to work in New Zealand
** In accordance with the Immigration Act 2009, you will be asked to provide evidence of your entitlement to work in New Zealand during the selection process.
If invited to interview, you will be required to bring original documentation with you. Please refer to our Frequently Asked Questions on our Contact Us page for more information.
